```{r}
library(TSA)

data(larain)

dev.new(width = 4.875, height = 2.5,
        pointsize = 8)

plot(larain,
     ylab = "Inches",
     xlab = "Year",
     type = "o")
```

```{r}
dev.new(width=3,height=3,pointsize=8)
plot(y=larain,x=zlag(larain),ylab='Inches',
xlab='Previous Year Inches')

```

```{r}
dev.new(width=4.875, height=2.5,pointsize=8)
data(color)
plot(color,ylab='Color Property',xlab='Batch',type='o')
```

```{r}


# Generate 48 independent normal random values
x <- rnorm(48, mean = 0, sd = 1)

# Convert into a time series
x_ts <- ts(x)

# Plot the time series
plot(x_ts,
     type = "o",
     main = "Random Normal Time Series",
     xlab = "Time",
     ylab = "Value")

```

```{r}
# Generate 48 independent normal random values
x <- rchisq(48, df=2)

# Convert into a time series
x_ts <- ts(x)

# Plot the time series
plot(x_ts,
     type = "o",
     main = "Chi Square Time Series",
     xlab = "Time",
     ylab = "Value")

```

# 3/ Plot and Test Normal

```{r}
# Generate 48 independent normal random values
x <- rt(48, df=5)

# Convert into a time series
x_ts <- ts(x)

# Plot the time series
plot(x_ts,
     type = "o",
     main = "t-distribution Time Series",
     xlab = "Time",
     ylab = "Value")
```
# Plot and Test Normal

```{r}

# Generate 48 independent normal random values
x <- rnorm(100, mean = 0, sd = 5)

# Convert into a time series

x_ts <-ts(x)

# Plot the time series
plot(x_ts,
     type = "o",
     main = "Random Normal Time Series",
     xlab = "Time",
     ylab = "Value")

plot(x,
     type = "o",
     main = "Random Normal Time Series",
     xlab = "Time",
     ylab = "Value")


mean_x = mean(x)
std_x = sd(x)

print(mean_x)
print(std_x)
```

# 

```{r}

dev.new(width=3,height=3,pointsize=8)
plot(y=x_ts,x=zlag(x_ts),ylab='Inches',
xlab='Previous Year Inches')


```

# Plot and Test Chi Square

```{r}
# Generate 48 independent Chi Square random values
x <- rchisq(48, df=2)

# Convert into a time series
x_ts <- ts(x)

# Plot the time series
plot(x_ts,
     type = "o",
     main = "Chi Square Time Series",
     xlab = "Time",
     ylab = "Value")



dev.new(width=3,height=3,pointsize=8)
plot(y=x_ts,x=zlag(x_ts),ylab='Inches',
xlab='Previous Year Inches')

mean_x = mean(x)
std_x = sd(x)
print(mean_x)
print(std_x)


```


# Test and Plot t-distribution

```{r}

x <- rt(48, df=5)

# Convert into a time series
x_ts <- ts(x)

# Plot the time series
plot(x_ts,
     type = "o",
     main = "t-distribution Time Series",
     xlab = "Time",
     ylab = "Value")

```
```{r}
dev.new(width=3,height=3,pointsize=8)
plot(y=x_ts,x=zlag(x_ts),ylab='Inches',
xlab='Previous Year Inches')

mean_x = mean(x)
std_x = sd(x)
print(mean_x)
print(std_x)

```
# 6 Plot data

```{r}
data(tempdub) 

plot(tempdub,type="o")
points(y=tempdub,x=time(tempdub),
pch=as.vector(season(tempdub)))

```
